messages:
Ravi K: Quick sync — partners pushed a couple dates for H100/H200 and MI300. Need to decide publish cadence for marketplace and comms.
Noor (mkt): Can we do one week soft-window + follow-up precise ship dates later? Prefer minimal churn for press.
NVIDIA - Leo: Soft-window ok. Request: mention performance as "expected" and avoid exact availability dates until we confirm inventory.
AMD - Ines: MI300 driver fix ETA tomorrow; shipping teams now targeting next-week ship. Could slide our enablement by 7 days.
Kai (infra): Impact: regen kernels for Gaudi takes ~24h; full canary runs another 24h. If driver lands tomorrow we can keep original publish week, otherwise +1 week.
Legal Ops: We'll prepare two announcement copy variants (soft-window + firm-date). Need partner approval; please allow 24h for review.
Ravi K: Plan proposal:
- Day 0: Partner prebrief + handoff assets
- Day 1-2: Infra canary and kernel regen
- Day 3: Legal + partner signoff on final copy
- Day 4: Marketplace publish (blocked until canary green)
Noor (mkt): I'll draft both asset sets. If we must delay, use soft-window to keep press queue flexible.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary-3512345678 -> https://ci.internal/3512345678/logs
Kai (infra): Canary running on 3 nodes; telemetry -> s3://redwood/canaries/3512345678/. Will report by 10:00 PT.
NVIDIA - Leo: We'll review assets after your canary pass.
AMD - Ines: Will update if driver slips.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, metrics -> s3://redwood/canaries/3512345678/metrics.json
Kai (infra): Validation PASS. No regressions; B200 thermal +2% but within SLO. Recommend note in release notes.
Noor (mkt): Sharing soft-window copy now. Legal looped.
Legal Ops: Review queued; expect signoff within 6h if no edits.
Ravi K: Thanks. I'll hold the publish date tentative and run partner call at 11am PT to confirm final go/no-go. If partners ask to delay, we'll publish soft-window and update later. :white_check_mark:
